استنتجا (form X)
# اِسْتَنْتَجَا (istantajā) /is.tan.ta.d͡ʒaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَنْتَجَ (istantaja)
# اُسْتُنْتِجَا (ustuntijā) /us.tun.ti.d͡ʒaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَنْتَجَ (istantaja)
# اِسْتَنْتِجَا (istantijā) /is.tan.ti.d͡ʒaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَنْتَجَ (istantaja)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
